# Database Migration Service

**Parity grade: A** · SDK `aws-sdk-go-v2/service/databasemigrationservice@v1.75.0` · last audited 2026-11-01 (`0c1472972`)

### Known gaps

- dmsengine scope: no object-mapping rules for Kinesis/DynamoDB; BeforeImageSettings (task-settings form), validation, LOB settings, CommitRate batching beyond batch size, parallel-load, CdcMaxBatchInterval, StopTaskCachedChanges*, TaskRecoveryTableEnabled and CreatePkAfterFullLoad are ignored; table-mapping data-masking-* actions, table-tablespace/index-tablespace targets, table-type view and the tuple/set/list/map data types are rejected; expression functions beyond the documented SQLite subset (modifiers, $AR_H_CHANGE_SEQ, $AR_M_SOURCE_COLUMN_*) fail the task
- dmsengine sources: no Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB or S3 Parquet source files; DDL on the source is not replicated (a column-count change suspends the table with Table error); PostgreSQL CDC cannot start from an arbitrary LSN or timestamp; Secrets Manager credentials resolve for the MySQL/PostgreSQL settings blocks only
- RDS Postgres docker instances take wal_level=logical only at create time from the parameter group (rds.logical_replication=1); ModifyDBParameterGroup plus reboot on an existing instance does not recreate the container, so a CDC task on it fails with wal_level is replica (blocker: services/rds/db_instances.go:1212 RebootDBInstance only flips status, and pgServerFlags at services/rds/engine_replica.go:229 is read once at container start; recreating a data-bearing Docker container on reboot is a change to the RDS engine lifecycle outside this service)

### Structural gaps

These do not block an A grade — no implementation could produce real data here because the underlying data source cannot exist in an emulator.

- DescribeDataMigrationsInput.WithoutStatistics: DataMigration.DataMigrationStatistics is never populated because the engine only drives classic replication tasks, not DMS data migrations, so there is nothing to omit.
- StartReplicationInput.PremigrationAssessmentSettings is validated (JSON object, ResultEncryptionMode enum, IncludeOnly/Exclude exclusive), but the FailOnAssessmentFailure gate never trips: every individual assessment passes since no source/target connectivity exists to check.
- CdcStartTime on CreateReplicationTask/ModifyReplicationTask/StartReplicationTask: validated against CdcStartPosition but not stored, since types.ReplicationTask has no CdcStartTime member and the engine consumes CdcStartPosition only. StartReplication echoes CdcStartTime on the Replication.
